title: Nourishing Spring Polish Turkey Ham Bowl
description: A hearty and flavorful Polish-inspired dish featuring turkey ham, served in a lacquerware bowl, perfect for a spring brunch.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, apple cider vinegar, dijon mustard, salt, and pepper to make the marinade.
Add the thinly sliced turkey ham to the marinade and toss to coat.
Let the turkey ham marinate for at least 30 minutes.
In a separate bowl, combine mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion.
To assemble the bowls, divide the mixed greens mixture among four lacquerware bowls.
Top each bowl with a few slices of the marinated turkey ham.
Sprinkle crumbly feta cheese over the top of each bowl.
Garnish with additional cherry tomatoes and cucumber slices, if desired.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
